issues.issue: Was the RAD's conclusion that the applicants failed to rebut the presumption of state protection in Poland reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: RAD erred on Poland's democracy level, NDP currency, sophistication and others' experiences in rebuttal.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants had to seek state protection in Poland; police were not shown to be agents of persecution.
issues.result_text: Applicants did not show the RAD's state protection decision was unreasonable; judicial review dismissed.
